description: This file implements the NotesService class that provides use-case operations for managing notes, including creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and status toggling (pinned, favorite). It interacts with repositories for notes and tags, and handles user permissions and errors.

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: Service class for handling note-related use cases, coordinating between repositories and handling permission and error logic.

methods.name: __init__(self, db: Session)
methods.description: Initializes NotesService with a database session and repositories.

methods.name: list[Tag] _resolve_tags_owned_by_user(self, user_id: int, tag_ids: list[int])
methods.description: Resolves list of tags owned by a user, verifies existence and ownership, raises ForbiddenError if any tag is invalid.

methods.name: create_note(self, user_id: int, title: str, content: str, tag_ids: list[int])
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided title, content, and tags after verifying tag ownership.

methods.name: get_note(self, user_id: int, note_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a note for a user by note ID; raises NotFoundError if not found.

methods.name: list_notes(self, user_id: int, limit: int, offset: int, tag_id: int | None, pinned: bool | None, favorite: bool | None)
methods.description: Lists notes for a user, filtered by optional parameters like tag, pinned, or favorite.

methods.name: search_notes(self, user_id: int, query: str, limit: int, offset: int)
methods.description: Searches notes for a user based on a query string.

methods.name: update_note(self, user_id: int, note_id: int, title: str | None, content: str | None, tag_ids: list[int] | None)
methods.description: Updates a note's title, content, and tags; verifies note existence and ownership.

methods.name: None delete_note(self, user_id: int, note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note for a user by note ID.

methods.name: set_pinned(self, user_id: int, note_id: int, value: bool)
methods.description: Sets or unsets the pinned status of a note.

methods.name: set_favorite(self, user_id: int, note_id: int, value: bool)
methods.description: Sets or unsets the favorite status of a note.
